points: \item Developed an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to identify reasoning flaws in AI outputs, ensuring high-quality 'golden' logic.
\item Engineered specialized datasets for testing bias and logical consistency, directly supporting the hardening of model reasoning.
\item Built self-correcting RAG systems that iteratively improved answer quality, mimicking the refinement process of an AI Trainer.
\item Conducted technical auditing of ML models by implementing rigorous validation metrics (Faithfulness, Relevance).
\item Designed batched query pipelines to evaluate models at scale, optimizing the feedback loop for training data generation.
\item Collaborated on defining ground-truth standards for complex data science problems, enhancing model performance on technical tasks.
